title: Hotel Booking Clone
scenario: A hotel email says your reservation will be cancelled unless you re-enter your card.

answers.A: Re-enter your card through the cancellation email.
answers.B: Reply to the email and ask for a new payment deadline.
answers.C: Open the booking platform or hotel app and check the reservation.
answers.D: Call the hotel using the number in your booking confirmation.

explanation: Cancellation threats exploit a booking you care about. The reservation record and a known hotel number are safer than the message link.
proTip: Never solve a booking problem through the message that created the panic.
